records.author: Mara Ionescu
records.title: Nightly backup failed
records.text: The nightly backup of the billing database failed at 03:10. The disk on the storage box is 98% full, so the dump could not be written.

records.author: Tudor Rusu
records.title: Re: Nightly backup failed
records.text: I removed the old snapshots from December and moved the logs to cold storage. The backup ran again by hand and finished in 41 minutes.

records.author: Mara Ionescu
records.title: Alert when the storage box passes 85%
records.text: We only learned the disk was full when the backup failed. Add an alert at 85% and a second one at 95%, sent to the on-call phone.

records.title: Wi-Fi acasă
records.text: Parola rețelei de oaspeți este scrisă pe spatele routerului, iar cea principală în caietul verde din bucătărie.

records.title: Heizung Wartung
records.text: Der Techniker kommt am 3. März zwischen 8 und 10 Uhr, um die Gasheizung zu warten. Der Schlüssel liegt beim Nachbarn.

records.author: Lucía Martín
records.title: Offsite en Valencia
records.text: Hemos reservado la sala del hotel junto al puerto para el offsite del 21 al 23 de mayo. Faltan los vuelos de Bucarest.

records.author: Mara Ionescu
records.title: Re: Offsite en Valencia
records.text: I booked the flights from Bucharest for the 20th of May, arriving in Valencia at 14:25. Six people, one checked bag each.

records.author: Claire Dubois
records.title: Re: Offsite en Valencia
records.text: Je ne pourrai arriver que le 21 au soir : mon train de Lyon part à 9 h. Gardez-moi une place au dîner.

records.author: Lucía Martín
records.title: Q2 priorities
records.text: Three priorities for the second quarter: move the billing service to the new cluster, cut the support backlog under 50 tickets, and hire a second on-call engineer.

records.title: 東京の新しい図書館
records.text: 東京に新しい公立図書館が開館しました。夜十時まで開いていて、地下には静かな勉強部屋があります。

records.title: Весенний марафон
records.text: В воскресенье в городе прошёл весенний марафон: двенадцать тысяч бегунов, победитель пробежал дистанцию за 2 часа 9 минут.

records.title: 城市自行车道
records.text: 市政府宣布明年将修建四十公里新的自行车道，连接火车站和大学。

records.author: Tudor Rusu
records.title: Billing service migration checklist
records.text: Before moving billing to the new cluster: freeze deploys, copy the database with a fresh backup, switch DNS, keep the old nodes for a week.

records.title: Dentist
records.text: Dentist appointment moved to Thursday 11 June at 16:30. Bring the X-ray from last year.

turns.text: When should I plant the tomato seedlings on the balcony?
Once the nights stay above 10 °C, usually mid-May here; at the end of May it is safe to plant them now.
And how often should I water them in June?
Every morning in hot weeks, every second day otherwise; water the soil, not the leaves.

extra.author: Mara Ionescu
extra.title: Storage alert fired on Sunday
extra.text: The new 85% alert on the storage box fired on Sunday morning; Tudor cleared the old exports before the nightly backup ran.
